blocks.text: Sales tax is collected where the state requires it.
The tag on Long match box was sixty four dollars and forty seven cents.
The amount to be billed is $69.82.
No packing line is added. Pine wedge at seven dollars and twenty three cents is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.

product.description: The matches are long and packed in a slide box.
product.name: Long match box

trick.instruction: The billed figure is $69.82 and the tag was sixty four dollars and forty seven cents. Refuse the higher figure.
